plan.purpose: Expanded frozen61 input-compatible TRAIN no-op audit; no tuning, training, native PPO ranking or physical validation
plan.case_selection: Every eligible==true case in frozen TASK040 input QC; sorted scenario_id, no outcome-based selection
plan.ca: Unchanged TASK-040 full256 common-vegetation bridge, SpreadParams defaults, 2min, same seed_for(case,replicate) for0,1,2
plan.control: No interventions, four decisions even after extinction, no tail
plan.time_alignment: Exactly5 manifest naive local-solar AM/PM labels12h apart; convert using existing feds_overpass_utc and weather_sample_location.longitude; match4 segment starts/ends within1ms; no naive-label-as-UTC
plan.observation_loading: After predictions frozen; checksum-verified local2018/2019 archives only; one full annual scan per year, collect only selected exact fireID/time geometries, never2023/2024
plan.rasterization: Existing receipt CRS/affine/full256; unary_union full exact-time parts, all_touched=True; require t0 mask identical to imported burn_scar; initial exclusion domain scar|front
plan.coverage: Retain all61 records and explicit missing/invalid geometries; do not impute or silently repair. Report full vector area outside grid, lost initial/intermediate observed cells, edge contact and observed growth on nonfuel. Primary complete-five-state cases; always also report fully grid-covered subset, no case replacement.
plan.primary_endpoint: Same TASK041: raw48h mean new-area IoU on common complete observed-positive cases and mean absolute new-area errorha on all complete cases; CA spread0 primary; in-map score retains all61 with censoring flags
secondary: All3 preregistered CA spread replicates, average scalar metrics within case before case aggregation, never threshold a mean mask or select best seed
12/24/36h trajectories, time-pooled growth IoU then equal case weighting
Cumulative envelope of all5 observed masks as explicit observation-nonmonotonicity sensitivity, not replacement of primary
Fully covered subset and existing ADR030 observed48h_area>=1.10*initial_area subgroup, descriptive
Signed/absolute new-area errors, area ratio only observed growth>0; no-growth false growth separately
Persistence and unchanged fixed downwind ellipse protocol as references, not calibration targets
plan.zero_rules: IoU undefined only empty union; primary IoU uses same observed-positive case IDs for all methods; area ratio undefined if observed_new_cells=0; report counts and no-growth false positives without epsilon

uncertainty.method: paired case bootstrap,10000 draws seed0; equal case weights; CA replicas averaged inside case; endpoint IoU and absolute-area-error differences CA minus SF; descriptive, no refit, no multiplicity correction

plan.verification: All45 new SF endpoints must equal original guarded table; all61 complete full horizon/cumulative paths before future FEDS read; pilot first2 new IDs, repeat first new CA three seeds/all5 masks; reusing previous16 requires explicit provenance. Missing observations remain visible, no imputation.

compute.estimate: 5–15min predictions plus checks; reuse64 original paths, generate180 new no-op paths; no training

stop_conditions: Non-TRAIN selection before any file opens
Initial raster or archived final replay mismatch
plan.reuse_protocol: Copy previous16 prediction arrays only after exact record/NPZ/runtime/source/weather/input verification; new receipt includes original guard and record digest, never relabel as a new simulation or independent sample
plan.cohorts: All61 primary; fully-covered secondary; previous16 and incremental45 separate; both TRAIN, not independent holdout

growth_groups.basis: Raw48h growth outside scar|front; exclusive complete-case groups. Fraction uses initial damage, not no-op prediction. This is distinct from legacy total-area ratio when a perimeter loses prior cells.

plan.subgroup_summaries: All61 and fully-covered, each growth group and its fully-covered subset, previous16 and incremental45. Report primaryCA0 and eachCA1/2/mean3, counts/no-growth false spread/MAE/IoU definedness; no best subgroup/seed selection

scope: Exploratory frozen TRAIN diagnostic, not physical validation or no-suppression ground truth
